integrity: Analytical inverse-branch/continuant proof; independent validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to reciprocal Gauss-hole parameters 1/m (integers m>=2), Euclidean gaps of the compact survivor hull, and Hausdorff distance after rescaling. Historical priority under equivalent continued-fraction terminology remains a risk because the full 1999 Mauldin–Urbanski reference was not accessible. Finite program checks do not establish the universal proof.
title: Complete gap hierarchy and sharp Hausdorff filling of restricted-digit Gauss survivors
